title: The Toll Troll arrives
motion_prompt: Over three seconds, the Toll Troll inclines his head slightly and tilts the same abacus a little toward the viewer while holding it at belly height. Every bead stays in its original packed group on the same side of its rod; do not slide, add, remove or separate beads. Keep his expression neutral, feet planted, body position and costume fixed, and the gate fully closed. Ease gently into the ending pose, without a bow, approving nod or reward signal. Use a fixed camera, unchanged pixel-art rendering and palette, stable scenery and lighting. No camera motion, text, dialogue, captions, symbols, particles or audio. This is a one-off neutral arrival introduction, not a response to player ideas or results.

allow: Once when the ch1-n1-reverse-tolls arrival panel first appears, before the child responds or the encounter begins.
stop: Stop at the final pose after the one-off introduction.
Stop immediately when the child leaves the arrival panel, navigates away, pauses, or the page becomes hidden.
With reduced motion enabled, show the first still frame and skip playback.
forbid: Never trigger from tentative ideas, conjectures, draft typing, chip choices, hint requests, tutor generation, correctness checks or answer results.
Never play as a response to a gate opening or staying shut, a Seal, completion or reward.
Never replay automatically, loop, delay input, change the closed gate, emit audio or display a timer.
